advancements.wsaws.root.title: How Curious...
advancements.wsaws.root.desc: The world is full of things to find.
advancements.wsaws.chorus_eaten.title: What Just Happened?
advancements.wsaws.chorus_eaten.desc: Consume a chorus fruit and find yourself someplace else.
advancements.wsaws.how_curious_ender_pea: You might be able to find a way to keep it from breaking.
advancements.wsaws.how_curious_crying_ob: Learn what the obsidian was crying about.
Observe the resonant properties of amethyst.
advancements.wsaws.dissonance.title: Dissonance
advancements.wsaws.dissonance.desc: Sculk and amethyst both have resonant properties, but won't fuse in a crafting table.
advancements.wsaws.harmony.title: Harmony
advancements.wsaws.harmony.desc: These shards seem to store frequencies.
advancements.wsaws.craft_crystal_shell.d: You made a regrowing shell, but it won't work on it's own. Find a source of energy.
advancements.wsaws.acquire_nether_star.d: You found a power source, but brute force simply won't do. There should be a more delicate workstation for this.
advancements.wsaws.craft_rift_core.title: Wavefunction Collapse
advancements.wsaws.craft_waystone.title: Hammer Time
advancements.wsaws.craft_waystone.desc: Now that you have the core, it's time to put two and two together. Drop an anvil on a Rift Core sandwiched between two blocks, and use a Rift Claw to connect it to its pair.
